sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Procedure for election of Speaker and Deputy Speaker
maudhui: (1) There shall be an election of the Speaker at any time during the First Meeting of a new Parliament and at the first sitting immediately after a vacancy occurs in the office of Speaker. (2) There shall be an election of the Deputy Speaker at any time during the First Meeting of a new Parliament as the National Assembly may appoint and also at the first sitting of the National Assembly immediately after a vacancy occurs in the office of Deputy Speaker. (3) The election of the Speaker and the election of the Deputy Speaker shall be by secret ballot and shall be conducted in accordance with the procedure prescribed by the Standing Orders of the National Assembly.
vifungu: (1) There shall be an election of the Speaker at any time during the First Meeting of a new Parliament and at the first sitting immediately after a vacancy occurs in the office of Speaker.

(2) There shall be an election of the Deputy Speaker at any time during the First Meeting of a new Parliament as the National Assembly may appoint and also at the first sitting of the National Assembly immediately after a vacancy occurs in the office of Deputy Speaker.

(3) The election of the Speaker and the election of the Deputy Speaker shall be by secret ballot and shall be conducted in accordance with the procedure prescribed by the Standing Orders of the National Assembly.
